regions.region: page 7 upper-left Scheme 4A(a), Ni(cod)2 electrolysis control
regions.finding: The existing 0.2 mmol 1a/3 equiv 2a control with Ni(cod)2 (10 mol%), bipy, NaBr, Et3N, H2O, Ar/DMF, Zn-anode/C-felt cathode, room temperature, 9 mA, and 2 h was visually confirmed: 3aa 53% NMR yield and 4a not detected. It is one cross-page control, not a new run.

regions.region: page 7 upper-left Scheme 4A(b) no-current table, entries X = 0.5, 1.0, and 2.0
regions.finding: All three rows are distinct no-current controls. Existing X=1.0 and 2.0 records were linked to the inspected image; the omitted X=0.5 row was added with 3aa/4a/6a NMR yields 7/5/6%. The printed symbolic bipy charge is 1.5X equiv and is retained as an unresolved arithmetic assignment.

regions.region: page 7 middle-left Scheme 4A(c), epoxide-only stoichiometric Ni(cod)2 control
regions.finding: The distinct 1a-only, no-current control was confirmed at room temperature for 2 h, giving 4a and 6a in 13% and 7% NMR yields.

regions.region: page 7 upper-right Scheme 4B(a-c), 2s-Ni tests and aryl-halide competition
regions.finding: Three separate controls were visually confirmed: stoichiometric 2s-Ni gives no 3as; catalytic 2s-Ni with 2a gives 3aa in 26% NMR yield and no 3as; competition between 2a and 2s gives 3aa/3as in 5%/37% NMR yields.

regions.region: page 7 lower-left Scheme 4C proposed Ni catalytic cycle
regions.finding: Classified as a mechanism: I--V are proposed Ni0/NiII/NiI/NiIII intermediates and not isolated preparations; the generic cycle ends in allenol 3.

regions.region: page 7 lower-right Scheme 4D DFT regioselectivity analysis
regions.finding: Classified as computational mechanistic analysis, retaining relative barriers 0 and 3.5 kcal/mol and H···H distances 2.26 and 2.07 Å for TSOA/TSOA'. It is not a reaction experiment.

regions.region: page 7 lower text, three-electrode and cyclic-voltammetry observations
regions.finding: Recorded the main-text mechanistic measurements separately: standard-condition operating cathodic potential ~−1.5 V; direct-reduction condition ~−2.4 V; 1a reduction −2.5 V shifting to −2.0 V with ZnCl2. Referenced SI figures were not imported or associated.
